steps.content: Making it through the fissure and out of the contamination, you find yourself in another dimension composed of strange characters. There is no physical server in sight. You've even lost the sensation of your own body, but you are certain this is the source of the contamination.

The high concentration of Mania is suffocating. Massive distorted information constantly assaults your brain, likely already affecting your senses. You have reached the source of Gray Mirror's contamination.
<color=#b0e7b4>[System Alert] Attention, Gray Mirror server has been invaded.</color>

<color=#b0e7b4>Exterminator: Is anybody there?

Exterminator: ??

Exterminator: These characters... Am I looking at what I'm saying?</color>

<color=#b0e7b4>Exterminator: Seems like the case. So, by invasion you mean me, huh? This space must be connected to the server Bianca mentioned before, isn't it?

Exterminator: IS ANYBODY THERE???

Hot Toddy_815: ?!</color>

<color=#b0e7b4>Exterminator: I remember you.

Exterminator: This ID... Simon?

Hot Toddy_815: How did you end up here too?!</color>
Exterminator: What do you mean too? Do you know what this place is? Hot Toddy_815: You don't know? So... it wasn't you who put me up for the vote?

<color=#b0e7b4>Exterminator: Tell me, why is it that you must blame everything on me?

Hot Toddy_815: But that's impossible! Then... who else could it be...

Mavik: ****, let me out or I'll smash this place!</color>

<color=#b0e7b4>Exterminator: Who's that?

Exterminator: That name looks familiar. I think I've heard it from the Public Security Bureau.

Hot Toddy_815: It's someone who got voted out.</color>

<color=#b0e7b4>Exterminator: I get it now.

Exterminator: So, this is the data space for recycling trash. All the purged users are still alive.

Exterminator: Didn't expect swear words to be censored in the data realm too. Is it because he's using his real name on the internet?</color>

<color=#b0e7b4>Hot Toddy_815: That means you got voted out too... I thought after I was gone, your suspicion would be cleared.

Exterminator: My situation is a bit special. I kind of got myself in here.

Hot Toddy_815: What? You... are you really the mastermind behind this?!</color>

Exterminator: You're quite persistent... Exterminator: Actually, I'm here to find the mastermind, or should I say, Gray Mirror's developer. Hot Toddy_815: Ha, I knew it wasn't you. I've heard Gray Mirror's developer is super competent and has superpowers. You don't look the part.

<color=#b0e7b4>Exterminator: ...Okay, then can you take me to meet this super competent developer?

Hot Toddy_815: The developer has been gone for a while, leaving the account inactive. Our invincible Gray Mirror doesn't need constant maintenance from the developer anyway.

Hot Toddy_815: But they did leave behind an admin account. Since you started causing trouble, the admin hasn't been online. It's all your fault!</color>

<color=#b0e7b4>Exterminator: ...Since April 2?

Hot Toddy_815: I don't know what you're up to again, but I'll tell you in advance: It won't work. There's been a forty-fold increase in Gray Mirror's users since your farce. It's still going strong now, isn't it?

Exterminator: You're still defending it even after getting purged... You're a real fan...

Hot Toddy_815: You wouldn't understand! Gray Mirror is the greatest app ever! The admin will protect the justice defenders who got sent here mistakenly. I'm sure the admin will come to save me soon!</color>
<color=#b0e7b4>[System Alert] New message from Admin</color>
<color=#b0e7b4>Hot Toddy_815: Speak of the devil! Here comes the admin!</color>
In the boundless darkness, blue and green dots of data form a new line of characters in the distance. That is the admin's message, according to Simon.

Your target is right there: the mysterious admin who's been cleverly evading you yet has chosen this moment to meet you. You think of the surge of Gray Mirror users in just a few days, and... the grand passage emerging before you that looks almost like a warm welcome.

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: Here's... Here's to getting e-everyone's attention with Gray Mirror... To finding my partner in justice! Cheers!
You suddenly think of her words. The uneasy feeling within you grows stronger.
